title: Horizon Gate: Company OKR Port-of-Record and Cross-Functional Alignment Playbook
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Establish a single source-of-truth 'Port-of-Record' for company-level OKRs and associated initiatives to reduce misalignment across Eng/Product/Design. This ticket defines the playbook: intake, mapping to quarterly roadmap lanes, decision gates, RACI, telemetry, and an escalation path.

Goals: 1) Eliminate duplicated initiatives by centralizing intake and mapping; 2) Provide a predictable gating mechanism for scope slippage and cross-team tradeoffs; 3) Surface OKR health across teams with clear signals used in weekly leadership sync.

Deliverables: - OKR Port-of-Record template (Confluence link) - Intake form + guardrails for new initiatives - Decision gate definitions (Intake, Sprint-gate, Launch) - RACI for cross-functional owners - Mapping spreadsheet and automation rules (labels -> lanes) - Dashboard spec for OKR health and initiative progress - Runbook for rebalancing capacity mid-cycle.

Acceptance criteria: - Template published and reviewed by Eng, Design, Security; - Intake flow validated with two pilot initiatives from infra and product; - Dashboard shows top-10 company initiatives with health signals; - Leadership adoption: weekly sync uses Port-of-Record to reassign runway.
